# Arista

> > NYC's trusted HVAC and refrigeration service provider offering commercial and residential solutions with 24/7 emergency support across the metropolitan area.

Arista specializes in comprehensive heating, cooling, and refrigeration services for commercial and residential clients throughout New York City and the surrounding metro area. The company provides installation, maintenance, emergency repair, and service agreements with expertise in premium brands like Daikin VRV systems.
